newsitem.title: CHINA: Germany's KNAUF sign China gypsum plant DEAL.
newsitem.headline: Germany's KNAUF sign China gypsum plant DEAL.

text.p: German construction materials company the KNAUF Group has signed a $31.8 million deal with a Chinese firm to open a gypsum sheeting factory in eastern China, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
KNAUF would hold a 69 percent stake in the new Lunan-KNAUF Gypsum Plate Co in Zaozhuang city in Shandong province, home to the Chinese partner Lunan Gypsum Group, Xinhua said.
Officials from the two groups had signed the contract on Thursday at a trade fair in the provincial capital of Qingdao, the agency said.
The joint venture would have an annual production capacity of 20 million square metres of various sizes and types of gypsum plates, half of which would be exported, it said.
